name: Atreyu
label: Victory Records
lede: Yorba Linda kids named their band after the boy in The Neverending Story and took a Victory Records album to number 9 on the Billboard 200. Twenty-two years in, they parted ways with the singer who started it all at 14.

eras.title: From Retribution to a Chicago contract
eras.text: Two kids in Yorba Linda, California, start a punk band called Retribution and rename it after a character in Michael Ende's The Neverending Story. Two small EPs and a lot of local shows later, Victory Records in Chicago signs them.

years.h: A punk band called Retribution renames itself after a boy warrior
years.p: Alex Varkatzas and Dan Jacobs started it around age 14 in Yorba Linda. As the line-up and sound changed, they took the name of Atreju, the hero of Michael Ende's novel The Neverending Story.
years.xp: Brandon Saller came in on drums at the invitation of his older brother Ryan Saller. Kyle Stanley was on bass and Travis Miguel on guitar.

years.h: Visions goes out with seven songs and no label behind it
years.p: Atreyu's first EP is self-released and sold at its own shows around Orange County, years before any label gets involved.

years.h: Fractures in the Facade of Your Porcelain Beauty lands on Tribunal
years.p: A five-song EP for the underground label Tribunal Records. Tulips Are Better, Someone's Standing on My Chest and Living Each Day Like You're Already Dead get reworked for the first album.
play: Fractures in the Facade of Your Porcelain Beauty

years.h: Victory Records signs Atreyu, and Chris Thomson takes the bass
years.p: Tony Brummel's Chicago label signs the Orange County band in 2001. Bassist Kyle Stanley quits, and Chris Thomson steps in for the first album.

eras.title: Eyeliner, screams and sung choruses
eras.text: On Victory, Alex Varkatzas screamed while Brandon Saller sang the choruses from behind the drum kit, over Gothenburg riffs and a lot of eyeliner. PopMatters' Adrien Begrand called them too goth for emo, too metal for punk and too emotional for metal. The Curse made them the label's hottest band.

years.src: Wikipedia: Suicide Notes and Butterfly Kisses
years.h: Suicide Notes and Butterfly Kisses was nearly The Death Rock Diaries
years.p: Eric Rachel produced it at Trax East and two other studios. It's the only Atreyu album with Chris Thomson on bass.
years.xp: By March 2006, according to Nielsen SoundScan figures cited on Wikipedia, it had sold more than 240,000 copies worldwide. In 2004, two years after release, it charted at number 37 on Billboard's Heatseekers and number 30 on Top Independent Albums.

years.h: MTV2 puts Lip Gloss and Black on Headbangers Ball
years.p: The video also plays on Fuse's Uranium. Ain't Love Grand is the other video from the debut.

years.h: Marc McKnight takes over on bass from Chris Thomson
years.p: Marc "Porter" McKnight joins Atreyu in 2004 and stays through every line-up to come. He cites Green Day as his foundational band and found Johnny Cash through Bleeding Through.

years.cap: Alex Varkatzas on stage in Cardiff, c. 2004
yt: Right Side of the Bed (official video)
years.h: The Curse enters at 32 and tops the indie chart
years.p: GGGarth produced it partly at Plumper Mountain Sound in Gibsons, British Columbia. Atreyu's second album hits number 32 on the Billboard 200 and number 1 on Independent Albums.
years.xp:
Videos for Right Side of the Bed and The Crimson were all over MTV2 and Fuse. Wikipedia notes a hired studio bassist played on the record even though McKnight was in the band.

The album went on to sell more than 500,000 copies and was certified gold by the RIAA on September 14, 2020, sixteen years after release.

years.h: Right Side of the Bed rides along in Burnout 3: Takedown
years.p: EA's crash-racing game puts a Victory metalcore band in front of millions of gamers.

years.h: Atreyu covers Bon Jovi for the Mr. & Mrs. Smith soundtrack
years.p: Their version of Bon Jovi's You Give Love a Bad Name goes on the soundtrack of the Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie film.
years.xp: Around the same time Her Portrait in Black went onto the Underworld: Evolution soundtrack.

eras.title: Number 9, then out the Victory door
eras.text: A Death-Grip on Yesterday put Atreyu at number 9 on the Billboard 200. Then the band jumped to Hollywood and Roadrunner, went arena-rock with John Feldmann, and toured with Avenged Sevenfold and Linkin Park.

years.h: A Victory metalcore band reaches number 9 with A Death-Grip on Yesterday
years.p: Josh Abraham produced it with the band at Pulse Recording in Los Angeles. It also tops Independent Albums, and it's Atreyu's third album and last for Victory.
years.xp: Victory shipped it with a DVD of the making of the album plus videos by other Victory artists. Reviews were mixed: 2/10 from the Collector's Guide to Heavy Metal, 5/10 from PopMatters, positive from AllMusic and Punknews.

years.h: Ex's and Oh's makes the Madden NFL 07 soundtrack
years.p: The first Death-Grip single reaches number 24 on Billboard's Hot Mainstream Rock Tracks. Brandon Saller's singing and Varkatzas's screaming split more evenly than before.

years.h: Atreyu leaves Victory for Hollywood and Roadrunner
years.p: Disney-owned Hollywood Records takes the band in America, and Roadrunner Records everywhere else.

years.h: Lead Sails Paper Anchor goes to number 8, then gold
years.p: John Feldmann produces Atreyu's first Hollywood Records album, and it trades metalcore for big hard rock. It becomes the band's best seller.
years.xp: To launch Becoming the Bull, the band's site ran a jigsaw puzzle that unlocked audio clips. American copies closed with a cover of Faith No More's Epic; European and Australian ones with the Descendents' Clean Sheets.

years.h: Atreyu headlines the Revolution Stage on Linkin Park's tour
years.p: After Taste of Chaos dates with Avenged Sevenfold and Bullet for My Valentine, Atreyu plays 45-minute sets on Projekt Revolution 2008, with Hawthorne Heights and Armor for Sleep on the same stage.
years.xp: That spring Atreyu co-headlined Australia and New Zealand with Avenged Sevenfold and Bullet for My Valentine, and headlined Taste of Chaos in the UK with Story of the Year and As I Lay Dying. On April 22, 2008, Lead Sails Paper Anchor came back as a 2.0 edition with new art, bonus tracks and a DVD.

years.src: Wikipedia: Congregation of the Damned · Wikipedia: Atreyu
years.h: Congregation of the Damned: Atreyu gets heavy again
years.p: Bob Marlette produces at Henson Studios in Los Angeles. It opens at number 18 with about 26,000 copies, and Brandon Saller says parts of Atreyu had gone missing.
years.xp: Varkatzas called the record a mix of everything the band had done. It had sold 121,000 US copies by August 2015. The band promoted it with five webisodes released every two weeks from September 1 to October 20.

eras.title: Eleven years in, a long break
eras.text: After a decade on the road Atreyu stopped, and everyone went off to make something else. Three years later a Facebook post promised a return to the sound of The Curse.

years.h: Atreyu tells fans on Twitter it's taking a long break
years.p: Alex Varkatzas says the band will recharge and focus on other parts of their lives. He starts I Am War with Brandan Schieppati of [[Bleeding Through|55fd865d-4a0d-4fd0-af19-7e6feb168ab8]].
years.xp: Varkatzas's tweet: "atreyu is taking a long long break after 11 yrs of rocking.we arnt breaking up but" He added that they weren't writing, recording or touring for a while.

years.h: Saller's Hell or Highwater puts out Begin Again, no screaming
years.p: Brandon Saller's band, first called The Black Cloud Collective, plays clean-sung rock. In December Travis Miguel's Fake Figures follow with the EP Hail the Sycophants.
years.xp: Miguel later spent about 18 months in 2013 and 2014 as a touring guitarist for Trapt.

years.cap: Atreyu at the Rawk Attack festival, Germany
years.h: Atreyu says it's back making new music
years.p: The same five members return. On September 5 they post So Others May Live on YouTube and as a free download, and on October 25 and 26 they play Slipknot's Knotfest.

eras.title: A reunion, two albums and a goodbye
eras.text: The reunion produced two albums and a 20th anniversary tour with a setlist the fans chose. Then, in 2020, the band and its founding screamer went separate ways.

years.h: After six years, Long Live comes in at number 26
years.p: Atreyu's comeback album reaches 26 on the Billboard 200. A Record Store Day 7" of 1,000 copies came out April 18.

years.h: In Our Wake is the last album with Alex Varkatzas
years.p: Atreyu's seventh album comes out October 12 and goes on tour that fall with Memphis May Fire and Ice Nine Kills.

years.h: Fans vote on a 20-song set for Atreyu's 20th anniversary tour
years.p: Atreyu books 27 cities with Whitechapel and He Is Legend. Kyle Rosa fills in on drums.
years.xp: The 20-song setlist came from an online fan poll. Tempting Fate and Santa Cruz are also on the bill.

years.big: "we invented metalcore. That may sound cocky but I don't care"
years.h: After 22 years, Atreyu and Alex Varkatzas announce they're done
years.p: Rumors surfaced August 22 and Varkatzas denied them at first. On September 30 both sides confirmed it. Brandon Saller moves out front, Marc McKnight takes screams and Kyle Rosa joins on drums. The line above is Varkatzas, years earlier, on where Atreyu sits in metalcore.
years.xp: Varkatzas went on: "We pre-date Poison the Well and Killswitch Engage and all those bands." In June 2021 he announced a new band, Dead Icarus, whose debut album ZEALOT came out October 31, 2024.

eras.title: Brandon Saller steps out front
eras.text: The drummer who used to sing the choruses now fronts the band. Atreyu made records with Travis Barker, released EPs one at a time, re-cut its best-loved album and went back on Warped Tour, while Dan Jacobs said out loud what he thought of Victory.

years.h: Baptize puts Travis Barker on Warrior
years.p: John Feldmann produces the first album since Alex Varkatzas left, on Spinefarm. [[Blink-182|0743b15a-3c32-48c8-ad58-cb325350befa]]'s Travis Barker, Papa Roach's Jacoby Shaddix and Trivium's Matt Heafy guest. Metacritic scores it 51.
years.xp: Wikipedia's article on Baptize says Varkatzas worked on the album shortly before being removed from the band, and he kept writing credits on it. The singles were Warrior and Underrated.

years.h: Dan Jacobs takes aim at Victory's founder on a podcast
years.p: Atreyu's guitarist says it about Victory Records' Brummel in a 2021 podcast interview on Two Week Notice. Victory had released Atreyu's first three albums.
years.xp: The label had fought in court with other acts, among them [[Hawthorne Heights|194eeda1-e662-43bc-b9be-32fc1afecc8b]] and A Day to Remember.

years.h: Atreyu drips out EPs, starting with The Hope of a Spark
years.p: The Moment You Find Your Flame follows on August 18 and A Touch in the Dark on November 3.

years.h: The Beautiful Dark of Life gathers the EP songs
years.p: Atreyu's ninth studio album puts the songs from the three EPs on one record.

years.h: Atreyu cuts The Curse again without Alex Varkatzas
years.p: Brandon Saller and Marc McKnight sing the parts that Varkatzas and Saller once split on the 2004 original.

years.h: Warped Tour again, and a new album, The End Is Not the End
years.p: Atreyu plays Welcome to Rockville in May, the revived Vans Warped Tour and Louder Than Life in Louisville in September.
